title: SF2688 (2021-2022 Regular): Eligibility to apply for a permit to carry a pistol at 18 years of age establishment

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 2): Unless a sheriff denies a permit under the exception set forth in subdivision 6, paragraph (a), clause (3), a sheriff must issue a permit to an applicant if the person: (1) has training in the safe use of a pistol; (2) is at least 18 years old and a citizen or a permanent resident of the United States;
